titulo: Präteritum: war, hatte and the modals: War e hatte

aula.titulo: Präteritum: war, hatte and the modals
aula.objetivo: Use the Präteritum of sein, haben and the modals (konnte, musste, wollte, durfte, sollte), choose between Präteritum and Perfekt in conversation and recognise the most common forms of the Präteritum in texts.

blocos.texto: Goal of the lesson. By the end of the four sessions, you use war, hatte and the modals in the past tense in speech, form the past tense of regular verbs, recognise the most common irregular ones (ging, kam, sah, fuhr) and know when to use the Präteritum and when to use the Perfekt.

blocos.contexto: Jonas asks Camila why she looked tired. Then, her diary.

linhas.ru: — Ja, sehr müde. Ich hatte viel Arbeit. Ich konnte nicht schlafen.
linhas.en: — Yes, very. I had a lot of work. I could not sleep.
linhas.audio: Ja, sehr müde. Ich hatte viel Arbeit. Ich konnte nicht schlafen.

linhas.en: — Did you have to work for a long time?

linhas.ru: — Ja, ich musste bis zehn Uhr arbeiten. Ich wollte früh gehen, aber ich durfte nicht.
linhas.en: — Yes, I had to work until ten. I wanted to leave early, but I could not. Camila's diary. Yesterday was a long day. I woke up at six, took the bus to work. At the office I worked a lot. In the evening Jonas came and we cooked together. Afterwards I watched a film and fell asleep quickly.
linhas.audio: Ja, ich musste bis zehn Uhr arbeiten. Ich wollte früh gehen, aber ich durfte nicht.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: war, hatte, konnte, musste, wollte, durfte work in speech. The other verbs in the past tense appear mostly in stories and texts.

tabela.english: I had a lot of work.

blocos.titulo: Sein and haben in the Präteritum, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: «Präteritum» is another form of the past, used more in WRITING and in texts. STEP 2: with «sein» and «haben», CONVERSATION also uses the Präteritum, instead of the Perfekt: we say «Ich war müde», not «Ich bin müde gewesen»; we say «Ich hatte Fieber», not «Ich habe Fieber gehabt». STEP 3: the forms of «sein»: ich war, du warst, er war, wir waren, ihr wart, sie waren. STEP 4: the forms of «haben»: ich hatte, du hattest, er hatte, wir hatten, ihr hattet, sie hatten. STEP 5: note that «ich» and «er» are the SAME (war, hatte), as with the modals in the present tense.
blocos.comparacao: English has the simple past: «I was tired», «I had a fever». In German, «war» and «hatte» do that job (and they even look like «was» and «had»).

exemplos.ru: Ich hatte Fieber und war krank.
exemplos.pt: I had a fever and was ill.

exemplos.ru: Als Kind hatte ich einen Hund.
exemplos.pt: As a child I had a dog.

erros.errado: Du warst krank? — Ich waren krank.

blocos.enunciado: Say 6 sentences about yesterday and about your childhood with «war» and «hatte».
Write 6 sentences in the Perfekt, with «haben» and with «sein».
